risks.risk: Engine model/series may be different from what’s claimed; price depends heavily on exact model and displacement.
risks.proof: Ask for a clear close-up photo of the engine nameplate/serial plate (including model and serial number) and the same plate in a second angle.
risks.if_unproven: Price as a generic used marine/industrial engine with unknown model and unknown condition (worst case: not proven working).

risks.risk: “Working/no knock/low mileage” not verifiable remotely; could have internal wear, bearing noise, or compression issues.
risks.proof: Request a short video of the engine starting from cold (or at least a cold start), idling, and a brief rev; include a sound clip and tachometer/ECU readout if available.
risks.if_unproven: Price as not proven working (worst case) and assume possible overhaul needed.

risks.risk: Missing parts or incomplete setup (cooling, alternator, starter, fuel system components) may affect usability and total cost.
risks.proof: Ask for photos of all accessories and connections: starter, alternator, fuel pump/injectors area, exhaust manifold, cooling hoses/impeller housing (if applicable), and a full inventory shot.
risks.if_unproven: Price as incomplete/unknown completeness (worst case) requiring parts sourcing.

risks.risk: Potential shipping/handling damage or cracked components not visible in one wide shot.
risks.proof: Request close-ups of the block, mounting feet, and any visible casting seams/cracks; also ask for underside photos of the sump/bell housing area.

proof_requests: Clear close-up photos of the engine nameplate/serial plate showing exact model (including '671' if that’s correct) and serial number (photo 0 is not readable).
Video of a cold start (or start after a short rest), showing stable idle and brief rev; include sound (no knock) and any RPM/tachometer reading.
Compression/leak-down test results or mechanic report (even a simple written test sheet).
Photos of all major accessories and the full engine inventory (starter, alternator, fuel system, cooling/exhaust connections) to confirm completeness.
